learning_outcomes.text: Will define the concepts used in food technology.
Will evaluate the quality of foods and the parameters affecting quality.
Will recognize food processing methods and learn their application in industry.
Will have knowledge about food preservation techniques.
Will gain the skill to conduct literature searches and make presentations.

syllabus_topics: Supercritical Extraction in the Food Industry
Cold Storage of Foods (Pre-cooling, Cold Storage, Controlled Atmosphere Storage, Modified Atmosphere Packaging)
bibliography: B. Cemeroğlu, “Meyve ve Sebze Teknolojisi I-II”, Gıda Teknolojisi Derneği Yayınları, Ankara, 2004.
R.P. Singh, D.R. Heldman, “Introduction to Food Engineering – Gıda Mühendisliğine Giriş”, Nobel Yayınevi, Yayın No: 1246, 2015.
M. Pala, B. Saygı, “Türkiye’de Soğuk Zincir Uygulamaları ve Geliştirilmesi”, İstanbul Ticaret Odası, Yayın No: 6, 1993.
